quests.console_failed_header: Failed to issue AWS Console URL

quests.empty_challenge: No problems in the Challenge category

quests.empty_hint_filtered: Check other categories under the "All" tab.

notifications.header_description: Operator notifications (newest first, max 100, polled every 60 s)

notifications.empty_hint: Notifications sent by the operator from the application admin console will appear here.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.no_event_header: This team is not linked to an Event
scoreboard.no_event_body: Legacy deployments (pre-Phase 1) do not support event-scoped aggregation.
scoreboard.frozen_body: To prevent last-minute rushes, the ranking is hidden from 30 minutes before the competition ends until the final result is published. The final ranking will be shown after the competition ends.

score_events.title: Score events
score_events.description: Your team's score history (auto-refresh every {intervalSec} s, newest first, up to 100)
score_events.empty_hint: Once the competition starts, score changes from HealthCheck uptime / flag submissions / hint reveals etc. will appear here.

problem_detail.deploy_missing_header: This problem is not deployed to your team
problem_detail.deploy_missing_body: jobId {jobId} is not in your team's deploy list, so details cannot be shown. Please contact the operator.
problem_detail.scoring_not_started_body: This problem is locked until the competition starts. Problem details, hints, and flag submission are inaccessible until then. Please wait for the operator's start signal.

sso_credentials.title: SSO Credentials
sso_credentials.description: One-click federated sign-in to the AWS Console. No personal AWS account needed.
sso_credentials.howto_body: Pressing the button below opens the AWS Console (CloudFormation stacks view) in a new tab, already signed in. Session TTL is 1 hour.
